note: Oracle for forge's spec-intent review slot (forge review, §7 line 227, issue #19). Hand-derived (R-CHAR-3). forge review extracts the pre-screened DECLARATIVE spec layer (per fn: req/ens/fx + referenced spec-fn declarations, NO bodies) as the intent-review artifact. PRE-SCREENING (R-DEFER-9): only battery-passing (certified, reject-free) contracts are intent-reviewable; a vacuous/rejected contract is flagged battery_failing and NOT surfaced. The extraction is deterministic; the verdict comes from the EXTERNAL pluggable reviewer.

intent_reviewable.name: corpus_sum
intent_reviewable.why: sum certifies L3 (battery-passing) -> intent-reviewable. The spec layer is sum's req + ens + fx (declarative) plus spec_sum's DECLARATION (name/params/ret/dec), NO bodies.

battery_failing.name: vacuous
battery_failing.why: ens true is a §7.1 vacuity reject (battery-failing). Flagged battery_failing, NOT surfaced for intent review (R-DEFER-9 — mechanical failure answered first).
